official_input: UAV: normalized position, velocity, progress, assigned flag, assigned queue, energy slot fixed at 0
Buoy: normalized position, queue/capacity, last arrival, progress, occupied, buoy-count ratio
UAV-Buoy edge: distance, hypothetical rate, ETA
UAV-UAV edge: distance, active-link interference ratio
objective.official_label: softmax over a frozen candidate pool of H=15 fly-toward payload increments
objective.official_reward: none; the high-level has no reward and no payload term inside decode
objective.phase5_hgnn_label: observable exclusive assignment: queue * current hypothetical rate / (distance + 1)
objective.phase5_hgnn_loss: order-free set NLL of that single assignment

utility_interface.alpha: free, not fit in this audit
utility_interface.source: H=15 fly-toward payload increment of the candidate assignment. SINR is already inside this number.
utility_interface.observable_now: yes, by offline shadow, not as a network input

utility_interface.source: q_k / (max q + 1e-8) only. Waiting time, AoI, and deadline are absent.
ETA already stored on the UAV-Buoy edge: distance / step length.

utility_interface.delta: 0 if payload gain is the label; nonzero only as an extra penalty
utility_interface.source: Active-link interference is already folded into the H=15 payload.
utility_interface.observable_now: edge exists; value is 0 when no link is active

utility_interface.source: L3-B does not expose energy. The UAV energy channel is a structural zero.
